root_cause.text: The dma_length() function in the Arm Ethos-U NPU driver performs arithmetic operations on untrusted user‑supplied command‑stream values (length, strides, sizes, offset) without overflow or underflow checks, allowing integer wraparound that under‑reports DMA region usage and bypasses subsequent bounds validation.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states “signed stride values may underflow when added to len”, “intermediate multiplications may overflow”, “len + dma->offset may overflow”, and “dma_length() error returns were not validated by the caller”. The patch adds overflow helpers (check_mul_overflow, check_add_overflow) and signed underflow checks, and propagates errors to the caller.
